tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅: chos bdag bar chad sel ba'i chos ka las: rdo rje phur pa dug gzer reg phung bzhugs:

ྈྈྈྈ ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ ma 'ongs skal ldan chos bdag skyes bu des: zab mo'i lung bzhin 'gro don skyong ba'i tshe: srin za g.yu 'brong yam shud lte phur gyi: sprul pa bla ma slob dpon slob mar brdzu: dngos dang brgyud nas bar du gcod par byed: khyad par thang nag stag sna dang: dmar rgyan bza' yi sprul pa 'byung: khyad par rgyan yan ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ rjes su 'dre rgod 'byung po sna tshogs kyis: dam sris rgyud dkrugs sna tshogs bar chad mang: de tshe bdag 'dra pad+ma'i rno myur thog 'dra'i lha mchog kī la ya: dug gzer 'thor bas reg phung 'di nyid nyams su longs: phyi nang phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad bar chad ni: gzugs can gzugs med gnod 'tshe rlung ltar 'tshubs pa 'joms: de phyir dus mthar 'di la gces par zungs: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ de yang stong nyid gzod ma'i klong yangs las: ma rungs gdul dka' 'dul phyir snying rje bskyed: zung 'jug ngang las rang rig hūm̐ mthing nag: bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i tsha zer gyis: gnod byed gdug pa can rnams gzhob tu bsregs: de nyid yongs gyur khro rgyal stobs 'dus kyi: ngo bo badz+ra kī la'i sku ru bsgom: zhal gsum phyag drug mthing dkar dmar ba'i zhal: kun kyang 'jigs rung srin po khros ltar rngam: g.yas gnyis rtse dgu rtse lnga nam mkhar 'phyar: g.yon gnyis kha ṭ+wāṃ me dpung gsor zhing spro: mtha' gnyis seng ldeng phur bus gnod byed gzir: dur khrod chas brgyad dpal gyi chas bcu rdzogs: spu gri'i khyung gshog nam mkha'i mthongs su 'phyar: sgro gseb me char gnam lcags thog ser 'beb: sku smad gnam lcags phur gzugs dmar hang nge: gnod byed dam sri ru tra'i snying la btsug: me dpung klong nas khro bcu khro chung 'gying: kī la ya sod hūm̐ phaṭa 'brug stong ldir: rang nyid khro rgyal kun 'dus bdag nyid che: thugs kar nyi dkyil dbus su mthing nag hūm̐: de la rtsa ba'i sngags phreng mthing nag bskor:

oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa kī li kī la ya haṃ shaṃ tri gnod byed dam sri bdud kyi snying la mā ra ya e hur thums rbad: thugs srog hūm̐ las dzaḥyig lcags kyu 'phros: gnod byed log 'dren dam sri 'byung po kun: mtha' mi mgo brnyan ban bon sna tshogs dbyibs: bkug pa mdun du lcags bsregs hom du bsgyel: sku smad phur bus gsor zhing brdabs pa yis: nyam thag gzir bsam ma yengs dmigs pa'i gnad: khyad par dngos su gsal ba'i gzugs de 'am: rmi lam cho 'phrul gang ston de nyid bsgom: gong bzhin gzir mnan phung po ye shes mes: gzhob tu btul zhing rnam shes thugs srog hūm̐: zhabs kyur bstim bsam skye med ngang du bzla: thun mtshams rang nyid khro rgyal gsal ba'i mthar: srung ba lnga yi gur khang phub pa'i nang: rang lus rdo rje'i go khrab zhu lugs su: gyon par bsam zhing rtsa ba'i sngags kyi mthar: badz+ra kā ba tsi hūm̐: badz+ra dz+nyā na pañca ra dz+wa la raṃ rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa: btags pa bzla ba kun tu srung ba'i mchog: ྈྈྈྈྈ de ltar ma 'ongs bskal pa dus kyi mthar: mtha' 'gong dam sri'i bar gcod las skyob byed: gzhan gyis mi thub dug zer reg phung 'di: bdag 'dra o rgyan drag sngags mthar thug go: man ngag mgul khug snying gi dkyil du sbos: ྈྈྈྈྈ sha dum brgya rtsa zan dum brgya rtsa chang gis bran bsang sbyang: stong pa'i ngang las sha khrag sogs 'dod yon gyi phung por bsgom: btsan 'brong yam shud: sa srin g.yu 'brong: lte phur dam sri sogs kyi rigs su gyur pa slob dpon gyi dam nyams: phrin las dang tshe la sri zhing rku ba: mtha'i 'dre rgod ma rungs pa rgyab rten du 'cha' zhing: snang srid lha 'dre g.yo zhing 'khrug byed thams cad: sha zan mchod pa 'di bzhes la: lan chags sbyongs: bu lon 'khor: 'khon bcugs sbyangs te: zhi ba dang bde legs su mdzod cig: sam+bhar brgya rtsa dang: bcu tshan re rer de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi dang bsngo tshig bcug go:
ྈྈྈྈྈ ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ o rgyan chos rje gling pas rlung gi 'khor lo byams pa'i snying mdzod nas spyan drangs pa'o/// /
